title: console Connect page: the API-key copy and client hints do not say an API key cannot build (ui half of #32766, ruling B on cloud#4329)
body:
domain:server#6 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cz8zK9vJDPeeVKJ4XP

Filing gate: ① a ruled card's remaining half, split out after measurement. Card #32766 item 4 (the account owner's ruling B on objectstack-ai/cloud#4329, comment 6826838112: keep the gate, add a hint only where a build door is mounted). The framework half is PR #32902 (os-dev report 6838354891, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the grade and the lane.

## What

The Console Connect page sends clients without browser sign-in to an API key, and its copy does not say an API key cannot build:

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/developer/en.ts`: `connectAgent.apiKey.body` (around :258), and the client hints `connectAgent.codex.hint` (:225), `connectAgent.workbuddy.hint` (:229), `connectAgent.doubao.hint` (:234), `connectAgent.qwenwork.hint` (:239).
- The same keys in all 11 locales of that namespace (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant).

## Expected

Per the ruling's constraint, the copy either shows a build hint only on a deployment that mounts a build door, or is worded so it never promises building. After PR #32902, a host with a build door can serve the same text in `initialize` as `dataOnlyInstructions`; the page should agree with it, not restate it differently.

Blocked-by: #32766

## Reader

The `domain:ui` seat, once PR #32902 has landed.

## Duplicate check

`is:issue connectAgent apiKey build`, `is:issue Connect page API key cannot build`: no open card tracks this copy.
